title: Reign of Christ
definition: The reign of Christ is His present and future rule as risen Lord and King over all things.
summary: Jesus reigns now and will openly reign in final victory.
christFocus: Christ rules His Church, governs history, defeats enemies, and brings the kingdom to fullness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Christ reigns at the Father's right hand. His rule is not postponed until the future only; He is Lord now.

His reign includes the care of His Church, the advance of His kingdom, the restraint and defeat of evil, and the final renewal of all things.

The reign of Christ gives believers confidence that history is not leaderless or chaotic.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: World events, suffering, and evil can make believers feel that no one is ruling. The reign of Christ matters because the risen Lord is not absent.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live under Christ's reign with courage and obedience. Pray for His kingdom to come and serve Him faithfully while waiting for final victory.
